shots.name: cover-checklist
shots.shows: The cover view: masthead with the progress summary and bar, the sticky filter controls, and the top of the 55-trophy checklist with official names, descriptions and grade pills — the tracker at a glance.

shots.name: guide-open
shots.shows: One trophy's guide expanded inside its card: the own-words guide text with its named sources beside it, its kind and missable flag, and the earned checkbox — cited guidance in place.

shots.name: roadmap
shots.shows: The roadmap section: the ordered stages on the road to the platinum, each stage naming the story chapters, missions, collectibles and counts to clear there, built from the official descriptions.

shots.name: missable-filter
shots.shows: The missable filter applied: only the missable trophies listed, each flagged with when it can be missed, with the spoiler setting on so unearned story trophies stay hidden — filters and spoiler protection at work.
